name: Ramen Carbonara
desc: Instant ramen tossed with crisp bacon, garlic and a gochujang, egg and Parmesan carbonara sauce.

source.title: Ramen Carbonara
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 packs instant ramen, such as Shin Ramyun
1 ramen seasoning packet (from the packs above)
2 large egg yolks (optional, one per bowl)

steps: Whisk the egg, egg yolks, Parmesan, gochujang and pepper into a thick paste.
Cook the noodles in boiling water according to the package. Save 1/4 cup of the cooking water, then drain.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, fry the bacon about 5 min until the fat renders and the edges crisp. Add the garlic and stir 30 sec.
Add the noodles and the seasoning packet and toss. Turn off the heat, add the egg mixture, and stir hard until it turns creamy.
Loosen with the saved water a tablespoon at a time until glossy. Serve with chives, sesame seeds and a yolk on top if you like.
tips: Turn the heat off before the eggs go in so they thicken without scrambling.
The garnish yolk stays raw; skip it or use pasteurized eggs if serving anyone who should avoid raw egg.
2 servings, about 620 cal each. Credited to Genius NG (Cooking with Genius).
